command:
set -eu
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS Comparison Worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl start inventory-worker
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker
systemctl is-active inventory-worker
